name: pt_blender
description: A general 3D animation template for Blender

folders.name: ANIMATION
folders.info:
## ANIMATION/

Animation data such as Alembic caches (.abc) and FBX takes.

Files may be prefixed `ani_` and may include scene and shot designation. Example: `bbo_ani_mland_070.abc`

folders.name: APP
folders.info:
## APP/

Mostly bash scripts used by the project `makefile`. Can also contain other scripts created during the course of the project, e.g. python snippets for use with Blender.

folders.name: COMP
folders.info:
## COMP/

Composite: Typically for render-intensive animations where post-processing is desired.

folders.name: CONCEPT
folders.info:
## CONCEPT/

Sketches and designs. Anything presented to client should go into `DAILIES/` or `DELIVERABLE/`.

folders.name: DAILIES
folders.info:
## DAILIES/

`make dailies` creates date-stamped folder and copies files created TODAY from WIP to DEPLOYFILES (settings in `.makerc`) while adding metadata.

Optionally, `make workbook` converts workbook asciidoc file in `COPY/` to DEPLOYFILES. `make stage` or `make dist` to synchronize update to shared location.

folders.name: DATA
folders.info:
## DATA/

Data files used in the project. CSV, geotiff, etc.

folders.name: DELIVERABLE
folders.info:
## DELIVERABLE/

Artifacts delivered to client.

folders.name: DOC
folders.info:
## DOC/

Documentation, such as project management worksheets and mind-mapping files.

folders.name: EDIT
folders.info:
## EDIT/

Shot sequences combined for review.

folders.name: FONT
folders.info:
## FONT/

Fonts used in the project.

folders.name: FX
folders.info:
## FX/

Volumetric and particle simulation project files and data (OpenVDB, etc.)

folders.name: ILLUSTRATION
folders.info:
## ILLUSTRATION/

Static graphics used in the project.

folders.name: LAYOUT
folders.info:
## LAYOUT/

Formatting and style information for document production.

folders.name: MATERIAL
folders.info:
## MATERIAL/

Material library for sharing between multiple models and scenes.

folders.name: MODEL
folders.info:
## MODEL/

3d models, appended or linked into scenes.

folders.name: PARKING_LOT
folders.info:
## PARKING\_LOT/

A temporary location to drop inspirational and informative material that may become an asset or `REFERENCE` later.

Files from various sources and types, such as previous projects, stock photos, models, or a random image search. Create an additional folder to identify the source. Locate licensed material to `<asset type>/.../LICENSED` (and document). Move files with no clear license to `REFERENCE/` -- and *use as reference only.*

Folder not version-controlled or part of a backup. Deleted at the end of the project.

folders.name: PORTFOLIO
folders.info:
## PORTFOLIO/

Prepared result for promotion, such as render frames/movies, prior to archival.

folders.name: REFERENCE
folders.info:
## REFERENCE/

Files used for *reference only,* such as articles, rendering styles, typography. Files not usually renamed except to replace illegal characters. Create folders to help identify the source.

folders.name: RENDER
folders.info:
## RENDER/

Output from EDIT or COMP further organized by sequence/shot. Not tracked (version controlled) or synchronized. Use, e.g. `make ...mp4`, and `make dailies` to collect files for review.

Locate final renders to `DAILIES/`, `DIST/` or `DELIVERABLE/`.

folders.name: SCENE
folders.info:
## SCENE/

File used to link/append-in models, materials, textures, etc. and for rendering an image, animation, or build an interactive product.

folders.name: TEXTURE
folders.info:
## TEXTURE/

Texture maps and texture-generating project files.

Not yet used for Quixel Mixer _Project_ files -- see `MIXER_PROJECT` for that.
